logistica.title: Real-time fleet tracking
logistica.description: A digital platform for monitoring vehicles and logistics operations in real time, supporting route tracking and operational control.
logistica.imageAlt: Mockup of a logistics SaaS platform with a map, vehicles on route, statuses and fictional operational indicators.
logistica.problem: Logistics operations need clear visibility over routes, vehicles and statuses to reduce friction in daily coordination.
logistica.solution: A management web platform that centralises the map, routes, indicators and vehicle information in an enterprise SaaS experience.

resolves.visibility: Operational visibility over fleet and active routes.
resolves.followUp: Simpler tracking of statuses, routes and vehicle information.
resolves.operation: A control point for organising dispersed logistics data.

salud.title: Digital credential and provider directory
salud.description: A digital experience that simplifies access to credentials, coverage information and healthcare provider search.
salud.imageAlt: Mobile and responsive health mockup with a digital credential, search, filters, map and fictional providers.
salud.problem: People need fast access to coverage information and providers without dealing with confusing or inaccessible interfaces.
salud.solution: A mobile and responsive experience that organises the credential, member data, search, filters and map through a clear, trustworthy interface.

resolves.access: Simple access to credentials and relevant information.
resolves.clarity: Clear visual hierarchy for sensitive data and frequent enquiries.
resolves.selfService: Self-service provider search from any device.

justicia.title: Intelligent judicial information management
justicia.description: A system for centralising, consulting and managing large volumes of information associated with judicial processes and case files.
justicia.imageAlt: Enterprise judicial application mockup with dashboard, search, case files, tables, filters and fictional data relationships.
justicia.problem: Judicial environments handle large volumes of information that require consultation, traceability and structure to operate with precision.
justicia.solution: A robust enterprise application for centralising case files, filters, indicators, tables and relationships between relevant data.

resolves.centralization: Centralisation of information linked to processes and case files.
resolves.traceability: Stronger traceability for consulting and connecting data.
resolves.consultation: Structured consultation of complex information through filters and visualisations.

fintech.title: Digital bank account management
fintech.description: A platform for consulting and managing financial information in a clear, secure and accessible way.
fintech.imageAlt: Fintech mockup with desktop dashboard, mobile app, accounts, balance, transactions, cards and charts with fictional data.
fintech.problem: Digital financial management needs to communicate security and precision without sacrificing clarity when consulting accounts, transactions and operations.
fintech.solution: A desktop and mobile platform that organises accounts, balances, transactions, transfers, cards and charts in a secure, accessible experience.

resolves.control: Clear control over financial information and recent activity.
resolves.security: An interface designed for trust, precision and safe navigation.
resolves.clarity: Simple reading of financial data, charts and indicators.

resolves.understand: Visual understanding of anatomical systems and structures.

resolves.learn: Educational experiences that turn complex content into active learning.

page.title: One energy line. Seven transformations.
page.description: The EKIN KRUZ process unfolds as a continuous scene: the signal starts chaotic, finds direction and becomes an evolving digital product.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: The Energy Line arrives as a scattered signal: it opens questions, detects patterns and begins turning uncertainty into actionable understanding.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: The signal finds a path: connections become organised, architecture maps appear and the roadmap defines where to invest energy first.

design.title: Design
design.description: Diagrams become interface: components, visual hierarchy and a design system start revealing how the product will feel.

engineering.title: Engineering
engineering.description: The line becomes data flow: it moves through modules, APIs and services until it assembles a platform ready to scale.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Every decision passes through test filters: risks fall, indicators light up and the product gains operational confidence.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: Accumulated energy moves through infrastructure, cloud and global networks to become an available, measurable experience.

evolution.title: Evolution
evolution.description: The line does not end: it branches, learns from real data and opens new cycles of optimisation, automation and innovation.
